high_level_description: A flat vector illustration of a small floating island carrying a single house and a tree, in a friendly editorial style suitable for a hero banner.

style_description.aesthetics: bright, friendly, geometric, soft pastel, optimistic
style_description.lighting: even flat lighting with a single soft long shadow on the right
style_description.art_style: flat vector illustration, bold clean outlines, geometric shapes, minimal noise, generous use of negative space

compositional_deconstruction.background: A pale sky-blue solid background with a single soft white cloud silhouette on the left and a tiny dot-pattern of stars on the right. No gradient.

elements.desc: A small floating island shaped like an inverted dome, the underside dotted with tiny triangular grass tufts hanging down. The top is flat and covered in a single low-poly green grass texture.
A simple two-story house on top of the island, white walls, a triangular terracotta roof, one square window and a small arched door, all in flat vector style with bold dark outlines.
A single stylized round-canopy tree to the right of the house, trunk in muted brown and canopy in two layered shades of green for depth.
